project: Wuxia Life P16 Origin-Driven Growth And Composite Destiny
description: Strengthen wuxia-life by making childhood more origin-shaped and age-appropriate, adding config-first origin and tendency surfaces, introducing theme-neutral composite destiny and rare-line support, and validating that origin, choice, and luck can combine into materially different 0-40 life outcomes without regressing current gates.

userStories.title: Audit current early-life variance surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current origin, childhood, and route-entry variance so that P16 targets the highest-impact wuxia experience gaps first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current early-life variance across origin, family resources, early teaching, social exposure, and childhood event pools
Mark each early-life surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record the current source of truth for each surface
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit age-inappropriate childhood agency points
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only inventory of age-inappropriate childhood agency points so that P16 can remove the most immersion-breaking early choices first.
acceptanceCriteria: Record the current childhood choices or route-entry moments that feel too strong or age-inappropriate
Identify which early actions are direct-adult behaviors, strategic build choices, or other childhood-fit violations
Note whether each problem is config-only, content-only, or runtime-bound
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write stage agency design rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit agency rules for childhood, youth, and adulthood so that later P16 implementation stories optimize toward a coherent wuxia-life model.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the target agency split for childhood, youth, and adult stages
Define the principle that childhood should be shaped more by origin and circumstance than by direct route choice
Define which kinds of actions are invalid, suppressed, or strongly limited in early childhood
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write origin-shaping design rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit origin-shaping rules so that later config and runtime changes model upbringing consistently rather than as isolated tweaks.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how origin can influence hardship tolerance, discipline, family obligation, learning access, and early worldview
Define which early-life differences should remain recognizable without becoming fully deterministic
Record which origin effects are expected to stay explicit versus implicit in later outputs
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Add explicit origin resource and exposure config fields
userStories.description: As a developer, I want explicit config fields for origin-linked resources and exposure so that upbringing differences can be tuned without embedding wuxia flavor into runtime logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or refine config fields for family resources, guidance quality, social capital, hardship exposure, or regional background
Field names and semantics are explicit enough for later config-only tuning
Schema remains compatible with current profile-first loading or a controlled migration path is documented
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add explicit origin worldview and shaping config fields
userStories.description: As a developer, I want explicit config fields for early worldview and shaping tendencies so that childhood personality effects can be authored without reading hidden runtime assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or refine config fields covering early discipline, endurance, caution, empathy, ambition, or social ease shaping
Field semantics distinguish immediate childhood conditions from later tendency effects
Schema remains profile-first and theme-neutral in shared logic naming
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Wire origin resource inputs into childhood event selection
userStories.description: As a player, I want childhood event selection to read origin-linked material conditions so that early life feels different based on where I came from.
acceptanceCriteria: Childhood event selection or weighting reads origin-related resource and exposure inputs through the existing world-profile path
At least 2 distinct origin resource patterns produce materially different childhood event tendencies
The wiring path remains theme-neutral in shared runtime logic
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Wire origin guidance inputs into childhood event selection
userStories.description: As a player, I want childhood event selection to read origin-linked guidance and social inputs so that upbringing differences feel believable rather than cosmetic.
acceptanceCriteria: Childhood event selection or weighting reads origin-related guidance quality, social capital, or worldview inputs through the existing world-profile path
At least 1 additional origin pattern beyond material resources produces materially different childhood event tendencies
The resulting differences are traceable in test or report output
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Restrict direct-adult childhood actions
userStories.description: As a player, I want direct-adult behaviors removed from early childhood so that the life simulation feels grounded instead of prematurely strategic.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit, suppress, or replace direct commerce and other clearly adult route-entry actions in childhood
The restricted actions no longer appear as normal early-childhood options
Replacement or suppression follows the approved childhood agency rules
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Preserve limited meaningful childhood choice
userStories.description: As a player, I want childhood to retain a small amount of meaningful choice so that the stage remains interactive without turning into a premature build-optimization phase.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve a small number of meaningful childhood choices that fit the target age band
Childhood outcomes are driven more by experience framing and environment than by explicit career-like decisions
The retained choices align with the approved stage agency split
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add inspectable childhood-to-tendency shaping rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want childhood experiences to map into later tendencies through inspectable rules so that early hardship and upbringing have visible downstream payoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or refine config-driven links between childhood experiences and later tendencies such as endurance, discipline, ambition, caution, empathy, or social ease
At least 2 childhood shaping patterns are encoded without relying on wuxia-specific names in shared logic
The shaping path can be inspected in structured test or report output
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Surface tendency shaping in later callbacks or summaries
userStories.description: As a player, I want later-stage outputs to reflect childhood shaping so that origin and upbringing have visible narrative payoff beyond hidden weights.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 childhood shaping patterns can be observed in later-stage callbacks, route pressure, or summary output
The surfaced effects remain legible without requiring manual log reading
The output path uses existing profile-first or summary pipelines rather than ad hoc debug-only hooks
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Define composite destiny requirement schema
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a general configuration model for multi-factor destiny requirements so that major wuxia outcomes are not unlocked by a single axis alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a configuration model for multi-factor outcome requirements
The model supports conditions across at least skill growth, social capital, resources, reputation, key choices, and special-event progression
The shared logic remains theme-neutral and avoids wuxia-specific naming
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add composite destiny progress reporting
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want composite destiny requirements to report partial progress and blocking dimensions so that balancing and debugging do not depend on manual code tracing.
acceptanceCriteria: Composite destiny evaluation supports partial progress or unmet-requirement reporting
Reports identify which dimensions are satisfied, missing, or blocked for a candidate outcome
The reporting path is usable from tests or report artifacts
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Implement martial-plus-nonmartial composite destiny outcome
userStories.description: As a player, I want at least one major wuxia outcome to require more than martial strength so that high-status destinies feel earned rather than linear.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement at least 1 representative high-level wuxia outcome using the composite rule model
The outcome requires more than martial growth alone
Composite destiny progress reporting explains the satisfied and missing dimensions for this outcome
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Implement organization-and-cultivation composite destiny outcome
userStories.description: As a player, I want at least one major wuxia outcome to combine social or organizational requirements with personal cultivation so that social standing matters alongside individual power.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement at least 1 representative high-level wuxia outcome that combines social or organizational requirements with personal cultivation
The outcome is authored through the shared composite rule model rather than custom one-off logic
Composite destiny progress reporting explains the satisfied and missing dimensions for this outcome
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Implement blocked-by-missing-dimension composite destiny outcome
userStories.description: As a player, I want at least one major wuxia outcome to stay locked when a critical dimension is missing so that destinies do not collapse into single-axis progression.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement at least 1 representative high-level wuxia outcome that is blocked when a critical dimension is missing even if one axis is strong
The blocked state is visible in composite destiny progress reporting
By the end of this story the phase has at least 3 representative composite destiny outcomes implemented
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Add rare event line config model
userStories.description: As a designer, I want rare event lines represented in config so that luck-based opportunities can interact with origin, stage, and prior choices without custom hardcoded branches.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how rare event lines are represented in config and linked to origin, stage, or prior choice conditions
The config model stays compatible with current profile-first loading or documents a controlled migration path
The shared logic remains theme-neutral in field naming
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Wire rare event probability and opportunity impact
userStories.description: As a player, I want rare lines to be possible but not guaranteed, and to materially alter later opportunity space when they occur.
acceptanceCriteria: Otherwise similar lives can diverge on whether a rare line occurs
Rare lines can materially alter later opportunity space rather than only adding flavor text
The wiring can be observed in tests or structured report output
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Build origin variance validation slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a validation slice that compares multiple lives across different origins so that P16 proves origin meaningfully changes the early life arc.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a validation slice or report that compares multiple lives with controlled origin differences
Demonstrate at least 1 case where origin meaningfully changes the early life arc
Save report output under docs/test-reports/
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Build origin-plus-choice-plus-luck validation slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a validation slice that demonstrates destinies emerging from the interaction of origin, accumulated choices, and rare opportunities so that P16 proves the intended wuxia-life pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a validation slice or report that compares multiple lives with controlled differences in origin, choices, and rare-line outcomes
Demonstrate at least 1 case where a composite destiny unlock depends on both accumulated choices and a rare opportunity
Save report output under docs/test-reports/
Relevant tests pass
